claim: Whole-run pace averages hide scene-specific costs, so measure rooms, transitions and actor modes separately and report slow updates, drift and largest excursion as separate numbers.

evidence.text: Opening-room timings missed a room-transition penalty; bench the original recording's room starts separately.
A room at 28 MHz needs its original time back: fit over all rooms, then wait at the game's clock.
A fixture starting in a duel or busy-looking death is not a sustained live scene; split windows by actor type or mode.
A room entry costs about 0.2 s more than the original before the limiter repays it.
A rare per-update water strip invokes 22 direct glyph hooks in one room; measure every room.
A steady 0.07% drift was counted as 13 frames ahead; steady drift and bursts are two numbers.
